verdict.rationale: Notte's core agent interface is natural-language driven. The GitHub README says you give AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites, the site promises "Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt. No selectors," the docs include a plain-English prompt example (log in to LinkedIn and extract messages), and an agent-start API runs web agents on your behalf. One hands-on report of a failed extraction on hyatt.com raises reliability doubts but does not show the natural-language interface itself is missing. Missing for 10: independent positive corroboration that natural-language tasks complete reliably, and in-depth documentation of what natural-language commands can do and where they stop.
